key_write_conflict_problem.error_message: InvalidUpdateError: At key 'input_data': Can receive only one value per step. Use an Annotated key to handle multiple values
key_write_conflict_problem.root_cause: Multiple parallel nodes attempting to write to the same state field simultaneously
key_write_conflict_problem.occurrence_scenario: When C1 and C2 parallel nodes both try to update 'output_data' field at the same time
key_write_conflict_problem.technical_explanation: LangGraph 0.2.38 treats each state field as a single-writer channel by default. Parallel execution violates this constraint.

strategy_1_annotated_fields.approach: Use Annotated type hints with merge functions

implementation.problematic_field: output_data: str  # This causes conflicts in parallel
implementation.solution_field: output_data: Annotated[str, merge_str]  # This allows parallel writes
implementation.merge_function:
def merge_str(left: str, right: str) -> str:
    return right if right else left

strategy_2_field_segregation.approach: Separate return fields for parallel vs sequential nodes

parallel_nodes_avoid: Do NOT return 'output_data' from parallel nodes
Do NOT return 'last_node' from parallel nodes

strategy_3_dedicated_merge_node.approach: Use dedicated merge node to consolidate parallel results

implementation.merge_node_purpose: Collect parallel_results and create unified output_data
implementation.merge_node_logic: Extract individual results from parallel_results list and combine into single output

list_merger.code:
def merge_list(left: List[str], right: List[str]) -> List[str]:
    return (left or []) + (right or [])

string_merger.code:
def merge_str(left: str, right: str) -> str:
    return right if right else left
string_merger.purpose: Handle conflicting string updates by taking latest

int_merger.code:
def merge_int(left: int, right: int) -> int:
    return max(left or 0, right or 0)
int_merger.purpose: Handle integer conflicts by taking maximum value

safe_fields.input_data: str  # Safe: Only written by entry point
safe_fields.completed: bool  # Safe: Only written by final node
safe_fields.parallel_count: int  # Safe: Only written by sequential nodes

parallel_node_safe_return.pattern: Return only fields that won't conflict with other parallel nodes
safe_fields: parallel_results: List containing only this node's result
node_history: List containing only this node's name
avoid_fields: output_data: Will conflict with other parallel nodes
last_node: Will conflict with other parallel nodes

sequential_node_return.pattern: Can safely return all fields as no parallel conflicts

merge_node_implementation.purpose: Safely consolidate parallel results without conflicts
merge_node_implementation.input_processing: Read from parallel_results field (automatically merged by Annotated)
merge_node_implementation.output_generation: Create unified output_data from individual parallel results
merge_node_implementation.conflict_avoidance: Only this node writes to output_data after parallel phase

conflict_testing_validation.test_scenario: Simultaneous parallel node execution (C1 and C2)
validation_points: C1 and C2 execute simultaneously without InvalidUpdateError
parallel_results field accumulates both results via merge_list
success_indicators: No 'Can receive only one value per step' errors
Both parallel results appear in parallel_results list

langgraph_0_2_38.default_behavior: Each state field is single-writer channel
langgraph_0_2_38.parallel_write_restriction: Multiple nodes cannot write to same field simultaneously
langgraph_0_2_38.solution_mechanism: Annotated fields with merge functions override default behavior
langgraph_0_2_38.breaking_change_note: Earlier versions may have handled this differently

error_identification.error_message_pattern: InvalidUpdateError: At key 'FIELD_NAME': Can receive only one value per step
diagnosis_steps: Identify which field is causing conflict (from error message)
Check if field has Annotated type hint
Verify merge function is properly defined
Confirm parallel nodes aren't returning conflicting fields

resolution_checklist: Add Annotated type hint to conflicting field
Test with simple parallel scenario first

guaranteed_conflict_free_formula.step_1: Identify all fields that parallel nodes might write to
guaranteed_conflict_free_formula.step_2: Add Annotated[Type, merge_function] for each identified field
guaranteed_conflict_free_formula.step_3: Implement proper merge functions (merge_str, merge_list, merge_int)
guaranteed_conflict_free_formula.step_4: Modify parallel node returns to avoid conflicting fields
guaranteed_conflict_free_formula.step_5: Use dedicated merge node to consolidate parallel results
